AboutHero.subtitle: Young Leaders Academy is more than an educational platform — it’s a global movement. We empower young people with the knowledge, skills and connections to create a better, brighter future.

FoundersNote.title: A Message from Our Founders
FoundersNote.quote: "We founded Young Leaders Academy because we believe that education has the power to transform lives, communities and nations. Our mission is to provide young people with the right tools, guidance and opportunities to become the leaders of tomorrow."

OurStory.p1: Young Leaders Academy was founded with a simple but powerful belief — that every young person, no matter where they come from, deserves access to world-class education, mentorship and global opportunities.
OurStory.p2: We started this journey to bridge the gap between talent and opportunity, helping students build the skills, confidence and connections they need to succeed in a rapidly changing world.
OurStory.card1Desc: We saw too many bright and talented young people without the right guidance, resources or access to global opportunities.
OurStory.card2Desc: To be a globally recognized academy that develops ethical, innovative and impact-driven leaders for a more inclusive and sustainable world.

OurImpact.title: Numbers That Tell Our Story
OurImpact.subtitle: Our growing community of learners, partners and alumni continues to create a positive impact around the world.
OurImpact.stat1Desc: Guiding young minds across the globe.

JoinOurJourney.title: Be Part of Something Bigger
JoinOurJourney.subtitle: Together, we can build a future where every young person has the opportunity to lead, innovate and create change.

HowToEnroll.subtitle: Joining Young Leaders Academy is easy. Follow these simple steps to begin your journey.

HowToEnroll.step4Desc: Get accepted and start your journey with us!

UniversitiesHero.subtitle1: Opening doors to exceptional academic experiences, global networks, and transformative university pathways.
UniversitiesHero.subtitle2: Young Leaders Academy connects ambitious students with international academic communities through university exposure, leadership programmes, exchange experiences, and strategic preparation for the world's most competitive institutions.

GlobalMobility.title: Study Abroad & Global Immersion Pathways
GlobalMobility.subtitle1: The world is the classroom. Our global mobility programmes give students the chance to experience international universities, engage with diverse perspectives, and develop the confidence to thrive in an interconnected world.
GlobalMobility.subtitle2: From summer exchange programmes and international seminars to cultural immersion experiences and cross-border leadership projects, every journey combines academic enrichment, cultural intelligence and meaningful global connections.
GlobalMobility.ben1Desc: Work with peers from different cultures and academic backgrounds.
GlobalMobility.ben2Desc: Experience world-class lectures, seminars and campus environments.
GlobalMobility.ben3Desc: Learn from experienced educators, professionals and global leaders.
GlobalMobility.ben4Desc: Gain access to competitive university applications and scholarship opportunities.
